rationale: Primary hexaploid crop host (A, B, and D homoeologous subgenomes); RefSeq CS v2.1 annotated transcripts.
Secondary cereal host (cv. Morex V3); major spot blotch and common root rot host.
Mycoparasitic biocontrol fungus with demonstrated Dicer-dependent RNAi machinery (Piombo et al., 2021).
Beneficial rhizosphere biocontrol agent used in cereal cropping systems (Kubicek et al., 2011).
Saprotrophic ascomycete reference within Trichoderma genus (Kubicek et al., 2011).
Beneficial entomopathogenic fungus deployed in integrated pest management.
Arbuscular mycorrhizal symbiont of wheat and barley roots exposed to soil/root-applied dsRNA.
